data.body: Final preflight for story 1fd4: make test PASS (7,357 passed, 29 skipped, 114 deselected; 13 existing Python 3.14 fork deprecation warnings; 28m34s). The first full run had one public routing-table contract failure because the new criterion was absent from EXPECTED_ROUTING; added no-file-impact=(0.95, advisory), reran the exact node green, then reran the full suite from zero to green. make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS, git diff --check PASS, guide validation [], two regenerations byte-identical, all touched src modules under the 800-line cap. Independent code review approved with no findings. Tests remain behavior/public-contract focused; no implementation-source grep or private-shape assertions.
